name: Strawberry
description: Strawberry (genus Fragaria, primarily the octoploid hybrid Fragaria × ananassa). Commercial fresh-market production splits into short-day (June-bearing) cultivars, which flower under short daylength and are grown for a concentrated harvest window, and day-neutral (everbearing) cultivars, which flower largely independent of daylength and support extended-season production. Created as part of the multi-berry portability audit (2026-08-20) to give berry_ids a resolvable target for berry-strawberry, mirroring berry-blueberry's own record and the same previously-identified gap (schema-assessment.md A-3, proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-1) that had only been fixed for blueberry.
